summary: Provider errors keep a bounded (4 KB, MAX_ERROR_BODY_BYTES) error body: HTTP status responses read up to 4 KB of the body into BackendError::HttpStatus{body} (shown in Display), and Chat/Anthropic/Gemini/Responses stream or JSON error objects keep their code/type and message text. New BackendError::ContextOverflow{message} (code context_overflow, not retryable) is classified from known markers (OpenAI context_length_exceeded / maximum context length / exceeds the context window, Anthropic prompt is too long, Gemini input token count .. exceeds the maximum, plus pi's overflow.ts fallbacks) on 4xx bodies and in-stream errors; an empty 413 is also overflow. ProviderEvent::Failed carries retryable (serde default false), and the headless view block plus view_model TurnFailed read it instead of hardcoding true.

Error text is flattened (control chars -> space) and truncated on a char boundary; a provider could in principle echo request content in an error body, which now reaches logs/headless output bounded to 4 KB. ContextOverflow falls into the core's generic Failed operation outcome (the provider rejected the request). ZE-232 is expected to consume ContextOverflow for compact-and-retry.
